help.title: Gameplay Help
care: Low hunger, cleanliness, energy, or health can limit actions. Food, cleaning, sleep, and care items restore these stats.
Mood affects sleep and interaction. Interact at 75 mood and 40 health to earn hearts.
Play, cleaning, and work spend stats. Repeated actions, weather, and seasons can change the result.
growth: Daily content resets at 5:00 local time. Birthday, anniversary, and festival rewards remain claimable for three days.
Daily wishes, Pomodoro, and Partner Schedules provide daily rewards. Partner Schedules unlock at Lv.3.
Use the garden to plant and harvest. Golden Apples are also used in Partner Dreams, so spend them carefully.
At Lv.20, raising all four schedule skills to Lv.6 unlocks Partner Dreams and trophies.
